create_TransformerBlockAgent: create a TransformerBlockAgent with specified embedding size, attention heads, and optional layer normalization
create_TransformerMultiBlockAgent: create a multi-layer TransformerMultiBlockAgent by chaining multiple TransformerBlockAgent instances with shared config
run_TransformerBlockAgent_forward: run the TransformerBlockAgent forward pass on workspace tokens either step by step or all at once
test_TransformerMultiBlockAgent_stepwise: test that stepwise and global forward passes of TransformerMultiBlockAgent produce identical outputs
review_TransformerBlockAgent_get_mask: review the TransformerBlockAgent _get_mask method that generates causal attention masks with optional step windowing
